comments.note: src/builders/persona-builder.ts: The three-layer partials initialization is clean — spreading `config.partials ?? {}` into the starting map is idiomatic and consistent with how `config.variables` and `suiteConfig.variables` are handled as optional base layers elsewhere in the file. No code smells or pattern deviations observed.

Reviewed runner.ts: relies on contract that plugins return the map. This is a pre-existing design choice (consistent with onBuildContext / onPostRender patterns) — not introduced by this WP. No regression introduced.
